approved.en: Russian drones have struck Ukrainian rail infrastructure, killing civilians at a station and on a platform in Dnipro, and night attacks have left 350,000 people without power in the same city. Ukrainian investigators have concluded that Russia committed war crimes by targeting civilians, while the EU has freed over 20 billion euros to potentially help Ukraine's defence. Germany and Ukraine are testing an armed ground robot for frontline deployment, and US pressure has led Ukraine to pause strikes on Russian oil refineries. Trump officials are discussing sanctions relief for a Russian fund, and a localized ceasefire in Oleshky has entered its third day. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Russiske droner har rammet ukrainsk jernbaneinfrastruktur, drept sivile på en stasjon og på en perrong i Dnipro, og nattangrep har etterlatt 350 000 mennesker uten strøm i samme by. Ukrainas etterforskere har konkludert med at Russland har begått krigsforbrytelser ved å målrette sivile, mens EU har frigitt over 20 milliarder euro for potensielt å hjelpe Ukrainas forsvar. Tyskland og Ukraina tester en bevæpnet bakkebot for utplassering i frontlinjen, og amerikansk press har fått Ukraina til å pause angrep på russiske oljeraffinerier. Trump-tjenestemenn diskuterer sanksjonslettelser for et russisk fond, og en lokalisert våpenhvile i Oleshky har gått inn i sin tredje dag. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Israeli raids across the West Bank injured Palestinians and led to arrests, while settlers assaulted activists and journalists in the occupied territory. Israel banned travel for Brad Lander after his detention in the West Bank and Jewish Israeli blocs rejected Palestinian support. In Gaza, Israeli strikes this week killed 21 people, an aid group reported worsening food insecurity as operations were sharply cut, and 21,440 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah continues to fire rockets and artillery at Israeli positions in southern Lebanon while Israel carries out air strikes on Hezbollah sites, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF investigation. Lebanese olive harvests proceed under the threat of drones and warplanes, and UN peacekeepers are withdrawing from Lebanon after pressure from Israel. Qatar has pledged reconstruction funding and announced a large solar plant project for southern Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I nordlige Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk, og drapet Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som har utløst en etterforskning fra IDF. Libanons olivenhøst fortsetter under trussel fra droner og kampfly, og FN-fredsbevarere trekker seg tilbake fra Libanon etter press fra Israel. Qatar har lovet midler til gjenoppbygging og kunngjort et stort solkraftprosjekt for sørlige Libanon. UCDP registrerte 4 335 dødsfall i væpnede konflikter i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: JD Vance has sent a letter to Iran's president urging a restart of peace talks while Qatar has called on Iran to end regional threats and reopen the Strait of Hormuz as a goodwill gesture. The IRGC reports that four tankers were struck by mines in the Strait of Hormuz and Iran's covert military network is moving hardware past the U.S. blockade. A top U.S. admiral briefed President Trump on possible attack options against Iran and the Pentagon dismissed a general accused of leaking classified information. An IDF soldier has been charged with spying for Iran in exchange for cryptocurrency, and oil prices have eased as the United States seeks renewed diplomacy with Iran. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

IRGC melder at fire tankskip ble truffet av miner i Hormuzstredet, og Irans skjulte militære nettverk frakter utstyr forbi den amerikanske blokaden. En høytstående amerikansk admiral briefet president Trump om mulige angrepsalternativer mot Iran, og Pentagon avsatte en general som ble anklaget for å lekke klassifisert informasjon. En IDF-soldat er blitt siktet for spionasje for Iran i bytte mot kryptovaluta, og oljeprisene har lettet ettersom USA søker fornyet diplomati med Iran. 123 kamprelaterte dødsfall har skjedd i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Fighting continues near Yemen’s Taiz as the UN urges humanitarian access. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Security forces dismantled a drug-trafficking network, arresting 31 suspects, and Erbil police detained four suspects in connection with a woman's murder, while the PMF denied having paid Iranian advisers. A memorial was unveiled in Erbil for victims of the 2024 Iranian missile attack.

approved.en: RSF forces have carried out drone strikes on a Darfur market, killing more than 100 civilians and damaging a power station that cut electricity to two states. The Sudanese army is accused of launching 162 drone attacks from Ethiopian territory, a claim Ethiopia denies. A Rapid Support Forces commander has defected from Hemedti’s forces, while an investigation has identified commanders linked to wartime rape. The UAE federal court sentenced eight people to life imprisonment for illegal arms supplies to Sudan’s army. A UN agency reports nearly 120,000 people displaced in Blue Nile state since January, and there were 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Den sudanske hæren (SAF) blir anklaget for å ha utført 162 droneangrep fra etiopisk territorium, en påstand Etiopia benekter. En kommandør i RSF har gått over til Hemedti-styrkene, mens en etterforskning har identifisert kommandører knyttet til krigs­voldtekt. Den føderale domstolen i De forente arabiske emirater dømte åtte personer til livsvarig fengsel for ulovlig våpensupplysing til den sudanske hæren. Et FN-byrå rapporterer at nesten 120 000 personer er fordrevet i delstaten Blue Nile siden januar, og det var 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

A UN envoy urged South Sudanese leaders to choose consensus over confrontation, and a documentary on local peacemaking was screened. Joseph Lagu, a South Sudan independence figure, died at age 94. approved.en: Al Shabaab fighters are intensifying assaults on Turkish-trained Somali troops in Lower Shabelle and ambushing units near Baidoa, while the group killed a former al-Shabaab finance chief in Lower Shabelle. African Union peacekeepers are withdrawing from four bases in Lower Shabelle and Ethiopia is pulling more than 3,000 troops from Somalia, reducing external military presence. The Somali federal government has agreed to acquire Pakistani JF‑17 fighter jets and the United States has imposed entry conditions on ships calling at Somali ports. The UAE carried out its first drone strike against Al Shabaab in nearly a year and piracy off Somalia’s coast is rising, with hijacked oil tankers and hostages reported. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: The United States has sanctioned Rwanda's defence ministry for supplying the M23 rebels and for operating a gold smuggling route that passes through Uganda to fund an Islamic State-linked insurgency in eastern DRC. Gold smuggling is now identified as a financing channel for IS-backed rebels in the region.
